title: TestingOutput
description: Structured output from the testing phase (mol-testing). Emitted by the test-runner step after exercising the real feature path. See docs/architecture/feature-testing-and-ci-watcher.md.

outcome.description: testing_complete = smoke (or test fallback) ran and matched plan; smoke_unsupported = `make smoke` target absent, silent fallback to `make test`; testing_failed = smoke ran and failed.

smoke_command.description: Exact command invoked (e.g. `make smoke` or `make test`).

smoke_exit_code.description: Exit code of the smoke / fallback command.

smoke_log_summary.description: Short human summary of what the smoke output showed. Tail-of-log is fine.

scenarios_exercised.description: Concrete behaviors driven past the unit/integration layer

observation_method.description: How the result was observed (log line, HTTP status, process exit code)

ci_url.description: PR URL whose remote CI was observed by ci-watcher (optional; included if the testing phase cross-referenced CI).

fallback_used.description: True when `make -n smoke` failed and the runner fell back to `make test`.

fallback_reason.description: Why fallback was used (typically: 'no `make smoke` target').

evidence_refs.description: bead msg-ids of related evidence (SmokeRan, SmokeUnsupported, TestPlanResult, CiResult).
